text: {"name":"tx_poll_complete","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Polls a transmit-command status word, clears the command start bit, updates TX queue/task state, and either queues follow-up work or returns to low-power sleep.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v2":"state","v3":"tx_cmd","v4":"tx_cmd_block","v5":"task_id","v7":"cmd","v8":"poll_timeout","v9":"tx_status","v10":"tx_status","v11":"list_base","v12":"tx_entry_base"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"uint16 TX/queue busy flag"},{"offset":68,"meaning":"pointer to active TX command/status block"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"pointer to TX command block with word-18 control bits"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"TX command status word (bit 0x20 completion, bit 0x40 auxiliary status)"}]}
